faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Patna Project Technical Support 1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Patna Project Technical Support 1 recruitment is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support 1 post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Technical Support 1 position at AIIMS Patna.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support 1?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a 10th pass with a Diploma in MLT/DMLT or equivalent and two years of experience, or a three-year Graduate degree with one year of experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Project Technical Support 1 post is 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support 1 position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 18000 Per Month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Patna Project Technical Support 1?
faq.answer: The application process is to be done via email, sending your complete application and required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may include an MCQ-based written test if the number of applicants exceeds 30, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Patna located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Patna is located in Patna, Bihar.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Project Technical Support 1 position is a contractual job.
